description: This PHP class 'InterviewAttachment' is an ORM entity representing an interview attachment in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It defines properties for attachment metadata (file name, type, size, content, comment, attachment type) and their associated getter and setter methods, as well as ORM mapping annotations for database persistence.

classes.name: InterviewAttachment
classes.description: ORM entity class for storing interview attachment details in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the attachment.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates this attachment with a specific Interview.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Gets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type of the attachment file.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment file.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the attachment file.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the attachment.
